raw_text: Protests erupted in South Kashmir following an encounter in Shopian district that left two militants dead and one soldier injured. Authorities imposed an internet shutdown across Shopian and Pulwama, but protest coordination continued through VPN-tunneled social media posts. Stone pelting incidents were reported at three locations. Security forces responded with tear gas and pellet guns.
clean_text: Protests in South Kashmir after Shopian encounter. Internet shutdown imposed but protest coordination continued via VPN. Stone pelting at three locations met with tear gas and pellet guns.
